title: Rear screen (LCD) at 3:2 in movie mode with the focus frames: VDF fills the 3:2 panel with the 16:9 live view, and the frame widgets expect the live view there (A7C II 2.01 port)
artifact: cpapp-b.bin, its loaded image in coprocessor RAM: the word is in the file, the change is made in RAM only
table: VDF fit-mode table 0x1e4bc8 and the frame widgets' rectangle tables 0xd7b560, 0xd7b5d8, 0xd7b650 (entry: rear panel, 16:9) [A7 IV addresses; A7C II: size table 0x1a53130+0x50, setting 0x1a533b4, id rows 0x25b7ee8, fit table 0x1f8f48, frame tables 0xec4310]

summary.replaces: lcdfill_v1, with which no focus frame is drawn on the rear screen (F966)

sites.note: VDF fit mode for a 16:9 picture on a 3:2 panel (table for picture code 2, entry for panel code 1): 3 letterbox to 0 fill. The rear screen then shows the squeezed 16:9 live view over the whole 3:2 panel, i.e. stretched x32/27 vertically [A7 IV 0x1e4bcc]
